name: tg-cross-border
description: Togo cross border and withholding reference for the 2026 tax year, covering individual fiscal domicile and source rules, arrivals and departures, corporate permanent establishments, nonresident service payments, dividends, interest and conditional parent subsidiary relief. Use it for retenue à la source, prestations étrangères, redevances, dividendes, intérêts, établissement stable, expatriation and double taxation. It separates the ordinary domestic withholding treatment from treaty relief that requires the actual operative instrument, and distinguishes a final investment withholding from a creditable nonresident service deduction. The Guide reflects the enacted shorter construction permanent establishment period and records missing treaty, declaration and implementation evidence rather than inventing treaty rates or a universal foreign tax credit.
